claimed_coverage: Tests that TiffExportParams struct has Pyramid, Tile, TileHeight, and TileWidth fields added by fix.patch, and that NewTiffExportParams sets correct default values for these fields.
fix_patch_grounding: The fix adds four new fields to TiffExportParams (Pyramid bool, Tile bool, TileHeight int, TileWidth int) and sets them in vipsSaveTIFFToBuffer to pass to libvips for advanced TIFF export features.
issue_context_used: The issue describes the need for pyramidal layers and tiled storage in TIFF export, which directly maps to the Pyramid and Tile fields added by the fix.
notes: Hidden tests verify the TiffExportParams struct has the new fields (Pyramid, Tile, TileHeight, TileWidth) by attempting to compile and run tests that access these fields. Without the fix, compilation will fail because the fields don't exist. The tests run from an external directory using go.mod replace directive to import the vips package from /workspace.
